summary: Implemented src/utils/slug.ts with toKebabCase(), isValidKebabCase(), inferSlugFromUrl(), isValidWorkspaceId().
toKebabCase trims whitespace, lowercases, collapses consecutive non-alphanumeric runs to a single hyphen, strips leading/trailing hyphens.
isValidKebabCase uses regex ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ rejecting consecutive hyphens, leading/trailing hyphens, and uppercase.
inferSlugFromUrl splits on both '/' and ':' to handle HTTPS and SSH Git URL formats, strips .git suffix, and runs result through toKebabCase.
isValidWorkspaceId enforces 2-6 uppercase ASCII letters via /^[A-Z]{2,6}$/.
All five acceptance criteria verified at runtime.

comments.note: isValidWorkspaceId in src/utils/slug.ts only accepts uppercase ASCII letters (A-Z). If workspace IDs with digits are ever required (e.g. 'AB1'), the regex /^[A-Z]{2,6}$/ would need to be updated. Worth documenting the constraint explicitly.

inferSlugFromUrl does not validate that the input is a well-formed URL before attempting to extract the repo name. An empty or malformed input produces an empty string rather than an error. Consider adding a guard if the caller passes arbitrary user input.
